items.title: Attention Is All You Need | alphaXiv
items.snippet:
Unrestricted self-attention is the only row with both O(1) sequential operations and O(1) maximum path length between any two positions. That advantage comes at the cost of O(n2d) per-layer arithmetic. Restricted self-attention trades the short path length for lower complexity; convolution is parallel per layer but needs multiple layers to connect distant positions.
